multisite_reverse_ctmc.description: Sampling the reverse CTMC of a uniform-noise discrete diffusion model on X = [15]^48 under a fixed budget of intensity evaluations (NFE). The evaluator owns analytic held-out data distributions (8 separated modes of unequal weight and sharpness), answers intensity requests exactly, counts NFE, and scores the returned samples against the exact target on site marginals, site-pair marginals and the (mode, log-likelihood) profile at budgets of 16, 32, 64 and 128 NFE, i.e. fewer evaluations than sites.
multisite_reverse_ctmc.notes: Scaled extension of the paper's Section 6.1 / Appendix D.1 analytic toy (15 states per site, Q = E/15 - I per site, T = 12, arithmetic time grid, theta = 1/2, exact scores) from one site to 48 sites, in the paper's matched-NFE, NFE-below-sequence-length regime (Sections 6.2-6.4). With one site a single intensity call reveals the whole target and the 15-state space can be enumerated, so the one-site toy cannot rank samplers; with 48 sites the joint space (15^48) cannot be enumerated, and the separated, unequally weighted modes make Markov-chain sampling on the data-end conditionals fail. The paper reports Figure 2 slopes on the one-site toy over 16-1024 steps with 10^6 samples (theta-Trapezoidal 1.937, theta-RK-2 1.543, last four points 1.819); the gym's convergence_order is a pre-asymptotic fit over NFE 16-128 on multi-site pair marginals and is not on that scale, so those slopes are kept under _paper_reported. The convergence_order entries in results record the paper's stated approximately second-order claim and are unchanged from earlier iterations.

_paper_reported.setting: one 15-state site, target uniform on the simplex, 10^6 samples, steps 16-1024, KL(p0 || q_hat)

log10_pair_kl_nfe16.description: log10 of the mean over all 1128 site pairs of KL(p0 || q_hat) on the 225-cell pair marginal, geometric mean over held-out instances, at 16 intensity evaluations per sample.

log10_pair_kl_nfe32.description: log10 of the mean over all 1128 site pairs of KL(p0 || q_hat) on the 225-cell pair marginal, geometric mean over held-out instances, at 32 intensity evaluations per sample.

log10_pair_kl_nfe64.description: log10 of the mean over all 1128 site pairs of KL(p0 || q_hat) on the 225-cell pair marginal, geometric mean over held-out instances, at 64 intensity evaluations per sample.

log10_pair_kl_nfe128.description: log10 of the mean over all 1128 site pairs of KL(p0 || q_hat) on the 225-cell pair marginal, geometric mean over held-out instances, at 128 intensity evaluations per sample.

log10_profile_kl_mean.description: log10 of KL(p0 || q_hat) on the joint profile (most likely mode, decile of the exact log p0(x)), 80 cells, averaged over instances and budgets. Sees mode proportions and the typicality of the whole 48-site configuration, which pair marginals can miss.

log10_site_kl_mean.description: log10 of the mean single-site KL(p0 || q_hat) (the paper's one-site quantity), averaged over instances and budgets.

convergence_order.description: Negative log-log slope of the instance-geometric-mean pair KL against NFE (16-128), after removing the first-order finite-sample floor (224 / 2n).
